prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original wide establishing illustration of Rivendell, the hidden elven refuge in a magnificent wooded mountain valley. Match the user's approved latest rainy-village pencil establishing image: delicate graphite and very muted brown-gray pencil contours, parallel hatching and fine crosshatching, airy restrained shading on very light near-white warm ivory drawing paper, subtle paper grain, plenty of clean pale paper between marks. No orange, peach or tan wash. Scene and composition: camera pulled FAR BACK and elevated to a high three-quarter view looking down across the valley, a scenic environmental establishing shot, not a character scene. Reveal the whole elven settlement integrated into forested cliffs and terraced rock ledges: graceful halls with long gently swept roofs, airy arched galleries, open courtyards, elegant slender bridges spanning a winding river and deep ravines. Several broad waterfalls cascade from high wooded ledges past the buildings into fine mist, with smaller falls feeding the river below. A main elegant residence sits among trees on a middle-ground terrace, supported by smaller buildings across the valley; architecture is beautiful, timeless and understated, organic curving craftsmanship rather than a huge ornate city. Natural stone outcrops, leafy trees, fern-lined paths and low stone balustrades frame the foreground; layered forest and soft mountain ridges fade lightly into the distance. Let the river, bridges and terraces guide the eye through a believable coherent place. No foreground people, no portraits, no giant figures, no visual emphasis on inhabitants: the city and landscape are the subject. Peaceful ancient refuge, spacious and quietly majestic. Draw waterfall foam, mist and soft daylight largely with untouched pale paper; lightly sketched clouds and distant peaks. Selective detailed linework on nearby architecture, progressively simpler lighter pencil marks with distance, enough open breathing room to serve as a setting background. Wide 16:9 full-bleed landscape, intended final export 2560x1440. Only soft graphite and subdued brown-gray pencil on pale ivory, no colored paint, heavy black ink fills, thick brushwork, photorealism, 3D render or glossy digital finish. No text, labels, runes, lettering, captions, decorative border, white bottom strip, black bars, watermark or UI.
